name: long-press-button
purpose: Hold-to-confirm button — a nq-button whose white progress pill fills over the hold duration, swapping the label to 'Keep pressing…' at 40% and firing 'long-press' at 100%; protects critical actions from accidental clicks.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the button must be held before 'long-press' fires, in milliseconds. Also drives the fill speed and the 40% 'Keep pressing…' prompt delay.

props.name: color
props.description: A nimiq-style button color class (light-blue, green, orange, red, gold) or 'inverse' for colored backgrounds (requires the button to share the background's stacking context).

notes: Sample state: rest (not pressed, no .indicator in the DOM), color light-blue (upstream default), slot label 'Hold to confirm', no subline; the frozen frame is exactly this rest state. Requires the nq-button base from nimiq-style.min.css (class='long-press-button nq-button light-blue'). Pressed behavior (interactive in the snippet/demo, not in the frozen frame): mousedown/touchstart/Enter/Space inserts the .indicator at width 0 which transitions to full width over duration ms; at duration*0.4 the labels cross-fade to 'Keep pressing…' (the ellipsis is the upstream \u2026 i18n string); at duration a 'long-press' CustomEvent fires; releasing early (document mouseup, touchend, keyup, blur) rewinds the fill within min(.3s, duration). Click events are swallowed (preventDefault + stopImmediatePropagation), only 'long-press' confirms. Both labels always stay in the DOM so the button never resizes. The label color switch inside the fill is two nested mix-blend-modes (mask lighten, indicator difference), which is why labels transition color/margin instead of opacity/transform (a new stacking context would break the blend). Vue 3 port trap: upstream's Vue 2 '.transition-indicator-enter' class is renamed '-enter-from'.
